diff summary:

need a pr description for Anika. she is reviewing this and needs to approve it before we deploy to staging.

diff:
- added retry with exponential backoff to the webhook sender. 3 files changed, +180 lines, -40 lines.
- retries up to 3 times. backoff is 1s, 2s, 4s.
- added jitter to the backoff so its not perfectly synchronized.
- tested against a local mock server that returns 500s. all 3 retries fire and it correctly marks the delivery as failed after the 3rd try.
- 8 new unit tests for the backoff logic, all green.
- untested case: thundering herd. if we have 1000 webhooks to send and the endpoint is down, they will all retry at roughly the same time even with jitter. i havent built a rate-limiter or a circuit breaker yet. not sure if we need one for v1.
- Anika needs to decide if we merge this as is and add rate limiting later, or block the pr on it.

write the pr description. dont tell her which way to go on the herd problem.
